Q6097.reason: Modern law construes 'heirs of his body' as creating a fee simple, so the niece's later conveyance also passed a fee simple.

Q5137.reason: An expert may base an opinion on facts reasonably relied upon by experts in the field, such as x-ray interpretation.

Q5526.reason: Breaking and entering a dwelling at night with intent to commit a felony (murder) inside constitutes common-law burglary.
